store2 2.14.4 MIT license selection

The npm package metadata for store2 2.14.4 declares the package license as MIT.
The distributed dist/store2.js file states:

  Copyright (c) 2024 Nathan Bubna; Licensed MIT

Some source files in the package offer a choice between the MIT and GPL
licenses and state:

  Copyright (c) 2022, ESHA Research

BWE Auto Trader uses and redistributes store2 solely under the MIT option.
No rights are exercised under the GPL option.
